changelog: **Fixed:** a programme's own vocabulary (#3400) shows on its admin pages again (`/admin/programs/[id]/…`). Since the admin dictionary was split per section (#3599), the programme layer re-provided the chrome-only `admin` scope and the journey page fell back to the org's words; it now re-provides `admin/programs`.

en: A programme's own terms (e.g. "guide" instead of "mentor") show on that programme's admin pages again.
tr: Bir programın kendi terimleri (ör. "mentor" yerine "rehber") o programın yönetim sayfalarında yeniden görünüyor.
de: Die eigenen Begriffe eines Programms (z. B. „Guide“ statt „Mentor“) erscheinen wieder auf seinen Verwaltungsseiten.
